_meta.description: Real Jira Cloud `jira:issue_updated` webhook with a NON-status changelog (a `summary` field edit). Top-level webhookEvent + issue{id,key,fields,self} + changelog{id,items[]} + user, per developer.atlassian.com. Each changelog item carries field/fieldtype/from/fromString/to/toString. The handler must emit an observation for this delivery (a field-level 'issue updated' draft capturing the changed field) rather than dropping it — only status/resolution changes were routed before. Doc-derived; values are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/webhooks/ (jira:issue_updated; changelog provided only on issue_updated; item fields field/fieldtype/from/fromString/to/toString)
